name: Nuclein

website_info.meta_description: Nuclein is a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in the United States. They focus on developing innovative therapies for genetic diseases. Their main products include gene therapy vectors designed to deliver genetic material to treat genetic disorders. Nuclein is exploring various modalities such as CRISPR gene editing and viral vectors for their pipeline.
